findings.evidenceJa: 異分子であったイリヤ
findings.governingReading: Illya, who had been a foreign element in the household
findings.explanation: Presence omits that Illya began as an alien element whom Saber and Rin have now rapidly normalized.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーだって回復しきっている
findings.explanation: Healed loses the explicit completeness of Saber’s recovery that licenses ending the day of rest.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと剣の鍛錬をする
findings.governingReading: He will train with Saber in swordsmanship.
findings.explanation: The fragment drops the specific discipline and leaves only generic training.

findings.evidenceJa: 今の発言は人聞きが悪すぎます
findings.governingReading: What you just said makes our training sound far too disreputable to anyone hearing it.
findings.explanation: Unpleasant removes Saber’s concern that Rin’s wording gives outsiders the wrong impression.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーにしごかれる
findings.governingReading: be put through hard drills by Saber
findings.explanation: Beaten up turns strenuous instruction into simple physical assault and weakens the joking teacher-student frame.

findings.evidenceJa: ぼうっとしてて聞いてなかった
findings.governingReading: He was spaced out and therefore did not hear what was said.
findings.explanation: The English drops Shirou’s distracted mental state and can imply deliberate inattention.

findings.highlight: You do not seem well today.
findings.evidenceJa: 今朝は覇気が感じられません
findings.governingReading: Saber can sense no vigor or spirit in Shirou this morning.
findings.explanation: Not well medicalizes and generalizes Saber’s observation of missing drive or force.

findings.highlight: Breakfast is a bit smaller than usual as well.
findings.evidenceJa: 朝食もどことなく色どりに欠けます
findings.governingReading: Even breakfast somehow lacks its usual color and variety.
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes visual variety and presentation into reduced portion size.

findings.highlight: I shall drive some energy into you later.
findings.evidenceJa: 後ほど活を入れてさしあげます
findings.governingReading: Saber will put some spirit back into him later through training.
findings.explanation: Drive some energy into you is nonidiomatic and can sound like literal magical transfer rather than a stern promise to rouse him.

findings.highlight: it’s only natural to assume they’re doing something
findings.evidenceJa: 何か動きがあったのは明白
findings.governingReading: It is obvious that some change or development has occurred.
findings.explanation: The English turns Rin’s inference from completed evidence into an assumption about unspecified current activity.

findings.highlight: the Master at the Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: The English identifies the troublesome temple opponent as a Master where Rin leaves the figure unspecified.

findings.governingReading: go out of your way to allocate time
findings.explanation: Take time off implies leave from ordinary duties rather than diverting limited investigation time to teach Shirou.

findings.highlight: He seems unreliable, so I can’t just leave him alone.
findings.evidenceJa: まだ危なっかしくて放っておけない
findings.governingReading: He is still too precarious or liable to get himself hurt for Rin to leave unattended.
findings.explanation: Unreliable judges dependability; Rin is describing danger caused by Shirou’s unsafe magecraft.

findings.highlight: your lessons were  unnecessary.”  not useful for Shirou.”
findings.evidenceJa: 凛の授業が必要ないなんて
findings.explanation: Two incompatible revisions, including mismatched quotation marks and a shift to third-person Shirou, remain active inside Saber’s sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 穏やかに、そんな言葉を返してきた
findings.governingReading: Saber answers him gently and calmly.
findings.explanation: The English removes the gentle delivery that makes her intimate claim about knowing Shirou’s body land as trust rather than aggression.
